title: How Do You Read the Sea Forecast Before a Boat Trip in Madeira?
description: Read wave height, swell period and wind direction together. On Madeira's south coast, a small long-period swell and a north wind mean a smooth boat trip.
heroAlt: White motor boat rising over a long, smooth Atlantic swell off Funchal in early morning light
keywords: how to read the sea forecast before a boat trip in Madeira
IPMA sea warnings Madeira south coast
is the sea calm in Funchal today

images.prompt: Early morning off Funchal, photographed from low on the water about 30 metres away. A white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy rides up the smooth face of a long, low Atlantic swell, the next swell line glinting behind it in soft gold light. Two passengers on board, seen from behind and small. In the background, the white houses of Funchal climb the green hillside under a clear sky. Realistic photo, true colours, no text, no logos.
images.alt: White motor boat rising over a long, smooth Atlantic swell off Funchal in early morning light

images.prompt: Long, smooth swell lines rolling in parallel towards Madeira's south coast at mid-morning, seen from a boat deck, sunlight catching each crest, dark cliffs in the distance, no people.
images.alt: Long parallel swell lines rolling towards Madeira's south coast in morning sun
